segments.t: “I have said these things to you
segments.note: 主語の「I」は λελάληκα に含まれる

segments.t: so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
segments.note: 主語（あなたがた）は σκανδαλισθῆτε に含まれる

segments.t: They will put you out of the synagogues.
segments.note: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσειν を「put you out of the synagogues」と句で訳す

segments.t: Yes, the time is coming
segments.note: ἀλλά を「Yes」と訳す

segments.t: that whoever kills you
will think that he offers service to God.
segments.note: 「that he」は δόξῃ（思う）の内容をほぐしたもの

segments.t: They will do these things
segments.note: 主語（彼ら）は ποιήσουσιν に含まれる。文頭の καὶ（1番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: because they have not known the Father nor me.
But I have told you these things
so that
when the time comes,
you may remember that I told you about them.
segments.note: αὐτῶν（10番、その時）は英語に現れない

segments.t: I didn’t tell you these things
segments.note: δὲ（18番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: from the beginning,
because I was with you.
But now I am going
segments.note: δὲ を「But」と訳す

segments.t: to him who sent me,
and none of you asks me,
‘Where are you going?’
segments.note: 主語（あなた）は ὑπάγεις に含まれる

segments.t: But because I have told you these things,
sorrow has filled your heart.
Nevertheless I tell you the truth:
It is to your advantage that I go away;
segments.note: 「It is to your advantage」は συμφέρει ὑμῖν のほぐし

segments.t: for if I don’t go away,
the Counselor won’t come to you.
But if I go,
I will send him to you.
When he has come,
segments.note: 「he」は ἐκεῖνος（主節の主語）を受ける

segments.t: he will convict the world
about sin,
about righteousness,
segments.note: καὶ（9番）は英語に現れない（列挙の読点）

segments.t: and about judgment;
about sin,
segments.note: μέν（3番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: because they don’t believe in me;
about righteousness,
segments.note: δὲ（3番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: because I am going to my Father,
segments.note: 「my」は英語の補い（τοῦ πατρός）

segments.t: and you won’t see me any more;
about judgment,
segments.note: δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: because the prince of this world has been judged.
“I still have many things to tell you,
segments.note: 「things」は πολλὰ への補い

segments.t: but you can’t bear them now.
segments.note: 「them」は前句の πολλὰ を受ける

segments.t: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come,
he will guide you into all truth,
for he will not speak from himself;
but whatever he hears, he will speak.
He will declare to you things that are coming.
segments.note: 「things」は τὰ ἐρχόμενα への補い

segments.t: He will glorify me,
for he will take from what is mine
segments.note: 「what is」は τοῦ ἐμοῦ のほぐし

segments.t: and will declare it to you.
segments.note: 「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: All things that the Father has are mine;
segments.note: 「things」は πάντα への補い

segments.t: therefore I said
that he takes of mine
segments.note: 主語の「he」は τὸ πνεῦμα を受ける

segments.t: and will declare it to you.
segments.note: 「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: “A little while, and you will not see me.
Again a little while, and you will see me.”
Some of his disciples therefore said to one another,
segments.note: 「Some」は ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν の部分表現

segments.t: “What is this that he says to us,
‘A little while, and you won’t see me,
and again a little while, and you will see me;’
and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
They said therefore,
“What is this that he says,
‘A little while’?
We don’t know what he is saying.”
Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him,
segments.note: 「Therefore」は英語の補い

segments.t: and he said to them,
“Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this,
that I said,
‘A little while, and you won’t see me,
and again a little while, and you will see me’?
Most certainly I tell you that
segments.note: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν を「Most certainly」と訳す

segments.t: you will weep and lament,
but the world will rejoice.
You will be sorrowful,
but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
segments.note: 「be turned」は γενήσεται のほぐし

segments.t: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow
segments.note: 「A」は定冠詞 ἡ の弱い訳

segments.t: because her time has come.
But when she has delivered the child,
she doesn’t remember the anguish any more,
for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
segments.note: 「human being」は ἄνθρωπος のほぐし

segments.t: Therefore you now have sorrow,
segments.note: μέν（5番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: but I will see you again,
and your heart will rejoice,
and no one will take your joy away from you.
“In that day you will ask me no questions.
segments.note: 「questions」は οὐδέν のほぐし

segments.t: Most certainly I tell you,
whatever you may ask of the Father in my name,
he will give it to you.
segments.note: 主語の「he」は τὸν πατέρα を受ける。「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name.
Ask, and you will receive,
that your joy may be made full.
“I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech.
segments.note: 「figures of speech」は παροιμίαις のほぐし

segments.t: But the time is coming
segments.note: 「But」は英語の補い

segments.t: when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech,
but will tell you plainly about the Father.
In that day you will ask in my name;
and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,
segments.note: ἐρωτήσω を「pray to」と訳す

segments.t: for the Father himself loves you,
because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.
I came from the Father and have come into the world.
Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”
His disciples said to him,
segments.note: 「to him」は英語の補い（αὐτοῦ を受ける）

segments.t: “Behold, now you are speaking plainly,
and using no figures of speech.
segments.note: 「using」は英語の補い。「figures of speech」は παροιμίαν のほぐし

segments.t: Now we know that you know all things,
and don’t need for anyone to question you.
By this we believe that you came from God.”
Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come,
segments.note: 「now」は英語の補い

segments.t: that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place,
segments.note: 「place」は τὰ ἴδια（自分のところ）への補い

segments.t: and you will leave me alone.
Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
segments.note: 「Yet」は καὶ を対比的に訳したもの

segments.t: I have told you these things,
that in me you may have peace.
In the world you have trouble;
but cheer up!
I have overcome the world.”
